the proposed method is able to achieve a classification accuracy of 99.3% on the German Traffic Sign data sets and 97.3% on DITS, with a processing time per image frame of 0.2 s on a single-core CPU.

we have developed an efficient system for traffic sign recognition that uses color segmentation to reduce the search area, HOG features, and deep convolutional neural network for classification, and we have evaluated the proposed approach on two challenging traffic sign data sets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a simple color segmentation can be used to improve the classification performance of a CNN-based approach, thus reducing the number of false positives.

, in the context of traffic sign recognition, a deep CNN can be trained to perform the classification task with high accuracy even if the input data is not preprocessed by means of complex feature extraction methods.
a simple combination of color segmentation with HOG and a CNN can lead to a system that outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches.
